data.name: Soul Food
data.detailed_description:
A survival RPG with Slow-burn weight-gain aspect! Lost on a pilgrimage, you end up in the ruins of a fallen kingdom. Feed on the animated guardians of this lost place to cultivate your various stats and abilities. Maybe even recruit other adventurers and guardians to your cause!

After getting lost in the desert, you luckily found a place to resupply for your trip back to civilization! Roam the halls for equipment and soul food. Delve deeper to discover the history of Okarim and its lingering curse. Explore the castle ruin's opulent walls, the lush oasis inside and the mysterious caves under it all. The remaining inhabitants hides within with knowledge about the past and present.

The soul food you collect from can shape your party’s offensive and defensive growth each level. Cultivate their strength, abilities and girth in the process. But beware! Grow too fast, and the curse will start to affect your abilities, forcing you to find ways to cure it! 

Each character fights using a deck of actions rather than traditional commands! Manage their stamina and adjust your strategy based on the encounters ahead! Bring the right utensils , you wouldn’t eat soup with a fork or corn with a knife!

A new take for the survival RPG genre, which we await for you to surmount.
